definitions.explanation: The proportion of a population that becomes infected with a disease, usually given as a percentage. Also used of computer viruses spreading through a network.

examples.japanese: {感染率|かんせんりつ}が{下|さ}がってきた。
examples.english: The infection rate has been coming down.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{感染率|かんせんりつ}が{全国|ぜんこく}{平均|へいきん}より{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The infection rate in this area is higher than the national average.

examples.japanese: {手洗|てあら}いと{換気|かんき}を{続|つづ}けたことで、{学校|がっこう}での{感染率|かんせんりつ}を{低|ひく}く{抑|おさ}えることができた。
examples.english: By keeping up handwashing and ventilation, we were able to hold the infection rate at the school down.

notes:
{感染|かんせん} (infection) + {率|りつ} (rate). Became everyday news vocabulary during the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感染率|かんせんりつ}が{高|たか}い: to have a high infection rate
- {感染率|かんせんりつ}を{下|さ}げる: to bring the infection rate down
- {感染率|かんせんりつ}の{推移|すいい}: the trend in the infection rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}: number of infected people — a raw count rather than a proportion
- {致死率|ちしりつ}: fatality rate — the proportion of infected people who die
